# ... (前序代码)

class AttentionCP(AttentionBase):
    """Context Parallel attention implementation for Ascend NPU."""

    def _pad_and_all_gather(
        self,
        qkv_fla: torch.Tensor,
        num_tokens: int,
        cp_size: int,
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, int]:
        """Pad qkv_fla to cp_size multiple and perform all-gather."""
        # ... padding 逻辑
        local_padded_num_tokens = _get_padded_num_tokens(
            num_tokens, cp_size
        )
        # 修复: 使用 output_padded.shape[0] 计算 local padded token 数
        # 原先可能使用了不准确的 num_tokens 计算

        return qkv_fla, local_padded_num_tokens

    def _forward_impl(
        self,
        qkv_fla: torch.Tensor,
        real_num_tokens: int,
        attn_metadata: AttentionMetadata,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        # 切片操作: real_num_tokens 与 qkv_fla.shape[0] 的关系未做断言
        sliced = qkv_fla[:real_num_tokens]
        # ... 后续 attention 计算
        return output
